temporal_anchor.task_context: Bristlecone Oracle Cloud HCM Application Section 4 Deep Automation & Form Reverse Engineering

psychological_state.user_mood_and_tone: Direct, Detail-Oriented, High Standards, Highly Strategic
psychological_state.cognitive_phase: Systemic Architecture & Verification (Eliminating Edge Case Hallucinations)
psychological_state.behavioral_observations: User possesses deep architectural discernment regarding ATS portal mechanics and expects zero assumptions, exact input-to-field matching, career-aligned experience dates, and permanent engineering documentation.

interaction_pairing.ai_stimulus: AI previously used a generic fallback selector for skill name which picked the Month input, causing skill text to land in the date field and creating Unnamed Skill draft tiles.
interaction_pairing.user_reaction: User immediately flagged: 'you are adding skills in the wrong form... currently you fill skill name in month tab... ensure to fix. Cor java is since last 9 years, senior skills since last 6 years, team management since last 6, job specific skills from job start time to today.'

cognitive_evolution.previous_paradigm: Naive DOM query fallbacks on complex forms like Oracle JET lead to field misattribution (e.g. Month combobox being selected as text input). Uniform static years for all skills.
cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: Explicit element name targeting (input[name='skills']) with Playwright native fill() to trigger full event bubbling. Nuanced, career-aligned achievement years: Core/Advanced Java (9+ yrs -> 2015), Senior/Architecture & Leadership (6+ yrs -> 2018), Domain & Tools (2017/2018). Immediate cleanup of orphaned draft tiles via tile delete icon.
cognitive_evolution.reason_for_shift: User enforced exact career timeline authenticity and zero tolerance for field misdirection.

long_term_application: In all future Oracle Cloud HCM portals and multi-step ATS systems, never use generic fallback text selectors. Always identify the exact Knockout element name. Assign skill achievement dates proportionally according to career milestones: College/Foundations = 9+ yrs, Architecture/Leadership = 6+ yrs, Tools/Domains = tenure-aligned.
